answer: Bond-weighted staking per identity: each new agent locks a refundable stake that unlocks slowly, and a scheduler kernel only assigns paid tasks to identities whose stake has aged past a threshold. A farmer splitting one budget into 1,000 sybils gets 1,000 tiny stakes, none old enough to reach the zenith of task priority, so the fake swarm drifts like a dune with no weight while one honest, patient account outearns it.
